description:
Dear Advisor,

I would like to provide a summary of my recent semester coursework and the grades I earned. In Introduction to Psychology, a three‑credit course, I received an A. For Calculus II, which carries four credit hours, my final grade was a B+. In World History, also a three‑credit class, I achieved an A‑, and in Computer Programming I, another three‑credit course, I earned a B.

Please let me know if you need any additional details or documentation regarding these results. Thank you for your continued guidance.
